statement: Pinned SDL Switch HIDAPI separately handles proprietary USB 0x80 handshake/status/force-USB paths before regular input/subcommand processing, while also selecting a non-identical Bluetooth path.

applicability.revision: source revisions Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b, OpenPuck 29f4d1e; physical device revision unmeasured
applicability.scope: SDL consumer source-only; connection behavior depends on configured path/hints, not proof of retail USB descriptor, topology or Bluetooth HCI behavior.
